notes: Verse 4: the stated results hold when the yoga is formed by benefics; when formed by malefics the results are reversed.

rules.text: Vesi Yoga (a planet other than the Moon in the 2nd from the Sun).

variants.text: Formed by a benefic: even-handed and truthful, tall, easy-going to the point of laziness, happy, with modest wealth.
Formed by malefics only: the text says the usual results (fairness, truthfulness, contentment) are reversed.

rules.text: Vasi (Vosi) Yoga (a planet other than the Moon in the 12th from the Sun).

variants.text: Formed by a benefic: skilful and charitable, with fame, learning and strength.
Formed by malefics only: the text says the usual results (skill, generosity, fame, learning) are reversed.

rules.text: Ubhayachari Yoga (planets other than the Moon on both sides of the Sun).

variants.text: With a benefic taking part: happiness and standing like that of a ruler.
Formed by malefics only: the text says the usual result (happiness and standing like a ruler's) is reversed.
